author: XBOX
description:
Take a look Guns of Eschaton co-op gameplay, a soulslike FPS set in an occult Wild West created by the late, renowned writer and worldbuilder Viktor Antonov (Half-Life 2, Dishonoured, Prey, Fallout 4, Wolfenstein: The New Order).  

This is not a fast-paced shooter where victory comes from reflexes alone. Every bullet matters. Every gun has its own character. Every monster has a weakness. So be smart with your ammo choice in each cylinder of your revolver. Learn enemy weaknesses and exploit them. Adapt your tactics with different bullet types, calculated parries and dashes, mystic abilities granted through occult means.

Go West and die with the country.

Coming to XBOX Series X|S. Wishlist today
